keyQuestions: Which structural changes would reduce drift and maintenance burden without over-generalizing?
answeredQuestions: Which structural changes would reduce drift and maintenance burden without over-generalizing?
ruledOut: Create one shared production eligibility module
Split the cache optimizer wholesale in one change

keyFindings.summary: Both forks need unique build identity and local provenance instead of unchanged upstream metadata.
A shared fixture matrix can prevent predicate drift without runtime package coupling.
Cache optimizer modularization should proceed by characterized responsibility seams.
Duplicate declarations and missing script packaging justify structural hygiene gates.
A machine-readable upstream base and patch ledger should make reconciliation auditable.
